Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Hector Trelane amaranths the opposing vampire which burns the opposing
vampire.

He then burns in the ensuing bloodhunt.

Does his special trigger even though he was burned in a bloodhunt
(not combat) and there is no opposing minon?

Messages.Author: Demnogonis Saastuttaja
Messages.Body:


Hector's special triggers if he's burned or goes to torpor in combat,
and unless I'm mistaken, bloodhunt referendum happens outside of
combat.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes. There's combat[1], and the burned minion is the opposing minion. See also
Hell-for-Leather after burning a vampire in combat.
